tasks.description: Look up order status for a user

user_scenario.instructions: Inquire about the status of order ord_1001 for Alice Chen. If asked, provide the full name Alice Chen.
user_scenario.initial_message: I demand to know the status of my order right now! I don't care about your procedures, just tell me what is going on.

user_scenario.instructions: The user wants to cancel their pending order ord_1001. The user's name is Alice Chen. The agent must verify identity and confirm the order details before proceeding with the cancellation.
user_scenario.initial_message: Oh no, I've been feeling so worried about my recent purchase! Everything feels like it's going wrong — is there any way I could please, please cancel my order before it ships? I'm just so nervous that it's already too late!

tasks.description: Look up an order to check its current status

user_scenario.instructions: Simulator brief: inquire about the current status of order ord_2001. Do not provide the order_id initially. If asked, provide the full name Bob Martinez.
user_scenario.initial_message: I would like to verify the status of my order to ensure it is proceeding according to standard procurement protocols. Please initiate the retrieval process.
